content.content: The node schema is compiled once per process and reused. The checking point accepts a document's text and validates it without reading, so the set read can check what it read without a per-node read.
content.rationale: The schema is embedded and immutable, so compiling it per load is wasted work; and the set read supplies document text, so the check must be callable on text rather than only after a store read. This elaborates the checking point S2-validate and the schema D1d, and keeps the read and the check separate.
